intents.name: GV3: the valley wakes
intents.description: The light returns: the world first, cut on the groove's two-bar lines, one longer travel.

intents.name: GV3: the lift
intents.description: Start on long moves and tighten to bar cuts by the boundary: the body arriving.

intents.name: GV3: the lead, the aurora
intents.description: Hold on the sky and whoever looks up at it; tighten only at the end.

intents.name: GV3: the suspension
intents.description: Locked off and held: two long frames while the visitor comes over the rim.

intents.name: GV3: the submerged break
intents.description: Dark and heavy under the water's lid: two close, still frames of the saucer settling.

intents.name: GV3: the riser's roll
intents.description: Every angle on the lift, and the cutting doubles with the roll into the drop.

intents.name: GV3: the light rebuilt
intents.description: Land on the crash, cut on the bar through the rebuilt valley, and open out to finish.
